variants.title: Not my crates
variants.premise: He is stacking wine crates on the dock and does not stop stacking.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask the crew. I do grapes.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: You must know something.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I know these crates are going on. You're not.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No captain wants the bother.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wine. Moonrise red, the dear stuff.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is it any good?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not for the likes of us. Don't lean on it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No. The grapes stay put and so do I.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Mind the gulls.

variants.title: The quiver
variants.premise: He is eating his lunch on the crates when he notices what is on the player's back.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The worker looks up from his lunch.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. Where'd you get that quiver?

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: In the Colosseum.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then don't waste it on me. Go to the capital.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Cothon. North side of the city.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask whoever keeps the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My cousin won't shut up about them.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He hasn't got one.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No. Show the ledger man, not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've crates to count.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Try not to drown.
